P.source: v=>{const N=Math.round(n(v,"n")),k=Math.round(n(v,"k")),p=n(v,"p"); let c=1; for(let i=1;i<=k;i++) c*= (N-k+i)/i; return c*p**k*(1-p)**(N-k)}

C.source: v=>{const N=Math.round(n(v,"n"));let R=Math.round(n(v,"r")); if(R>N) throw new Error("r cannot exceed n."); R=Math.min(R,N-R); let c=1;for(let i=1;i<=R;i++)c=c*(N-R+i)/i;return c;}
